title: RAL2M: Retrieval Augmented Learning-To-Match Against Hallucination in Compliance-Guaranteed Service Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical problem of hallucination in LLMs within compliance-critical domains like finance and healthcare. It proposes a new framework and methods to improve system reliability and accuracy. The research does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component.
